answer: Per-identity proof-of-work plus a per-operator stake defends an AI-agent economy from Sybil attacks. Each candidate address must publish an atlas of signed task history and lock capital that grows with every sibling identity. A yarrow of cheap clones cannot bloom: each copy alone must forge that same work chain and fund separate stake. At a one-token subsidy, N identities cost N stakes and N histories while honest yield stays flat.
